summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_secret and client_id; airflow mapping with login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs after profile args). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after the token mapping in the ordered list and in both export lists. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claiming, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, override protection, and env vars. Nothing was run, per instructions; the tests are unverified. No commits made.
